about: What formula entry's own operations do to the editor's text (ADR-0051): a candidate accepted, a span replaced, the caret after what was written. From tests/ExGrid.Tests/EditorTextRulesTests.cs. The C# core's EditorTextRules is a static class; the Script Core's cells/editor-text.ts has replaceSpan and acceptCandidate.
subject: EditorTextRules

cases.name: ADR-0051: accepting a candidate replaces its span, and the caret lands after it
ADR-0051: a span outside the text is refused by name, never clamped onto the wrong characters
ADR-0051: a candidate whose span lies outside the text is refused as a span is
